g.text: Logical structure of the procedural LAMP application
Exits with JSON on configuration / connection failure.
Logical ownership: Color.UserID refers to User.ID.
The SQL schema declares no foreign key constraint;
the API does not enforce that the user exists.
«entity» = conceptual class corresponding to a database table (Users or Colors).
«module» / «script» = grouped functions, not literal JavaScript or PHP classes.
Solid line = domain association with multiplicities; dashed arrow = dependency.
Operations group procedural functions by file. Types summarize values, not PHP type declarations.
AssociativeArray = decoded PHP array for a valid JSON object request.
sendResultInfoAsJson() writes an already serialized JSON string to the HTTP response.
Browser state and cookie supply userId; there is no server session class.
